Keep no-store caching headers on failed login and discarding any session credentials; no cookie.
Logout destroys server session and credentials; per-server cookie deletion dropped.
After changing own DB or account password, refresh stored session or vault credential.
Keep inactivity logout and clearing cached privileges; use DBLoom session idle timeout setting.
Idle timeout may be configurable within environment bounds, not per-user cfg override.
Logout must be POST with CSRF protection.
Re-login after expiry without losing page state; CSRF token refresh handled by framework.

Keep Referer-leak protection for external links via Referrer-Policy/noreferrer; no url.php redirector needed. See SEC-TGT-043.

Show clear error when upload exceeds configured size limit; no PHP empty-request heuristic or session message.

Client IP resolved only via configured trusted proxies, validated; CIDR support. See DEP-TGT-122 and .env settings.
Keep: login failures never leak internals, DB error text escaped, server paths not shown.
Keep CSPRNG for tokens, challenges and secrets via Node crypto; drop printable-ASCII masking.
Keep authenticated encryption for any stored secrets (vault, session); use AEAD in Node, no cookie-held credentials. See SEC-TGT-020.
Keep a maximum password length against DoS; value chosen by DBLoom, applied to all login forms, reasonable limit with hashing.
Keep NUL stripping and target host validation against allowed target list (SSRF); no p: prefix or regex setting.
Keep: any failed decrypt or verify yields invalid input, never throws to user; applies to vault and tokens.
Keep: goto/back/return targets validated against internal route allow-list to prevent open redirects.
External links open with noreferrer to https allow-listed docs hosts at most; no url.php redirector needed.
Keep generic denial messages not revealing rules and idle-logout notice; drop AllowNoPassword wording.
Keep safe rendering of messages: escape by default, no raw HTML; limited formatting and safe links only.
Keep: user-influenced file names never reach filesystem unsanitised; use identifiers and resolved-path containment instead of dot replacing.
Keep upload validation, symlink rejection, readability checks, server-dir containment; drop PHP is_uploaded_file mechanics.
Keep sanitised filename, Content-Disposition attachment, correct type, no-cache for downloads; drop obsolete headers.
Keep context-aware output encoding; React escapes by default, JSON embedding must escape script-breaking sequences.
Keep backtick quoting with doubled backticks; drop MSSQL compat mode. Implement in the MySQL/MariaDB adapter.
Keep 404 for unknown route and 405 for wrong method semantics; implemented by TanStack Start router, no PHP route table.
Outbound requests (updates, AI provider calls) must verify TLS certificates and hostnames.
Redirect only to internal targets, never user-supplied external URLs; PHP session close and IIS details dropped.
